say: You land hard. Every face in the boat turns to you.
That really happened. One officer fired his pistol to stop people jumping into his boat.
Then you see who's sitting next to you. Her.
She sent the bowler hat after you, while the real diamonds stayed hidden in her glove.
Then the boat stops. Halfway down.
Above you, someone is holding the rope. Bowler hat. And a knife.
Do you climb back up and face him, or grab her glove and take the real diamonds?
Comment climb or grab, and follow.
